summary: V3-008 freeze (plan revision 1 at 655d16a0 and its reviewed successor): independent evidence of the charge dependence of ion lateral spreading (He/C/O in water, 50–430 MeV/u) and independent coverage of the f_dM extrapolation above the 300 MeV proton domain are unavailable, and so are measured C/O ranges in water with uncertainties (row V3); request data access or acceptance of the gaps as recorded.

investigation.blocked_claim: V2-ION / decision 0043 §3: 'the ion multiple-scattering model (exact-Ω mapping of the proton f_dM model) reproduces the charge dependence of lateral spreading of He, C and O in water at 50–430 MeV/u' as an independently evidenced claim; 'f_dM evaluated at proton-equivalent states above the 300 MeV proton-qualified domain (up to about 2.5 GeV) is covered by independent evidence'; row V3 'ionmc C/O ranges in water agree with measurement' cannot be evaluated and stays an EVIDENCE GAP without the input.
investigation.budget: Bounded investigation completed before the freeze: P6 measured-range access (two access approaches, ≤ 2 h); P6 lateral-data search (19 candidates); P10 single-scattering availability with the Geant4 Coulomb-model lineage reading (G4CoulombScattering, G4eCoulombScatteringModel, G4WentzelOKandVIxSection, G4IonCoulombScatteringModel, G4IonCoulombCrossSection, G4EmParameters; 11 pinned sources) and ten scorer-free smokes; P11b/P11c f_dM-extrapolation quantification. No further autonomous route exists: the remaining candidates are paywalled, unpublished or of unknown provenance, and every accessible single-scattering engine shares the screened-Coulomb lineage.
alternatives: P6 measured range (p6-measured-data-access.md): Sihver 1998 FAILED; V3 EVIDENCE GAP (bundled by orchestrator decision (e))

P10 / V5-SS branch B (p10-single-scattering-availability.md §7.4.1–7.8): held-out Geant4 single-scattering ion/ion ratios at common velocity; shared screened-Coulomb lineage; differential f_dM coverage only
I11-abs (informative) against the committed Molière–Hanson reference and I11-ext (report-only): theory-anchored within the same Molière theory, SEEN pre-freeze, not independent
Informative relative check against text-quoted thesis ratios (P6-lateral §3): beamline-confounded, no uncertainties, cannot discriminate the ±5 % model uncertainty

attempts.approach: Search for measured He/C/O lateral widths or angular spreads in water (Parodi 2013, Schwaab 2011, Tessonnier 2017 PMB and thesis, Besuglow 2022, Krämer 2016, Phillips LBL, Wong 1990, Bevalac, Matsufuji 2005, HIMAC, MedAustron, geant-val; Gottschalk survey)
attempts.outcome: EVIDENCE GAP: no tabulated He/C/O data in water with uncertainties; thesis figures and beamline-confounded text ratios only; key papers paywalled; Phillips provenance unknown; Gottschalk arXiv:1204.4470 §5.3 concurs

attempts.approach: Measured C/O Bragg-peak positions in water (Sihver, Schardt, Kanai 1998, J-STAGE)
attempts.outcome: FAILED: curves normalised horizontally to the calculated peaks, figures only, oxygen = 18O

attempts.approach: Geant4 single-scattering thin-slab reference (P10): constructor coverage, Coulomb-model lineage per particle from pinned sources, scorer-free smokes incl. the 1 mm slab
attempts.outcome: Available and affordable (g4em-standard_SS; 1 mm slab, ≈ 2.94 h REF at the 6e4-primary design), but the ion path G4IonCoulombScatteringModel shares the screened Rutherford law and Born form → branch B, shared-lineage evidence only; the proton path is a different model (not a valid z = 1 reference)

attempts.outcome: Withdrawn as independent coverage: the common-velocity ion/ion ratio covers it only differentially (≤ 1.5 pp)

attempts.outcome: Drift ≤ 1.5 pp from 300 MeV to 3 GeV (protons, water); the reference carries ≈ 3 % uncertainty for water (not validated directly; Pb cleared by attribution; compound rule checked against Gottschalk's implementation) → declared limitation, not independent evidence

reason_autonomous_resolution_not_possibl: The only independent physical evidence of the charge dependence of ion lateral spreading would be measured data, and the bounded search (P6 lateral-data search, 19 candidates; P6 measured-range access; P10 single-scattering availability with Geant4 lineage reading and smokes; P11b/P11c extrapolation quantification) found none accessible in numeric form with uncertainties: the measured He/C/O lateral profiles in water (Tessonnier et al. 2017 PMB 62:3958; Schwaab et al. 2011 PMB 56:7813; HIT campaign data "available from the authors", Besuglow 2022) are behind publisher paywalls or held by the measuring groups (EXPERIMENT.md permitted category 1: paper behind inaccessible authentication, data only the operator may be able to obtain). Every single-scattering MC reference available to the autonomous system (Geant4 through OpenTOPAS, G4IonCoulombScatteringModel) shares the screened-Coulomb cross-section lineage of the model under test, so plan revision 1 (amended STOP 4 clause) excludes it as independent evidence; the held-out V5-SS row stays as shared-lineage evidence (branch B). The f_dM extrapolation above 300 MeV proton-equivalent (states up to ≈ 2.5 GeV at the standard points and upper ends) is bounded only within the same Molière theory (row I11-ext). For row V3 the only open candidate for measured C/O Bragg-peak positions (Sihver, Schardt, Kanai 1998) is unusable (curves normalised horizontally to the calculated peaks, figures only, 18O). Autonomous resolution is therefore not possible; integration is not blocked (plan STOP 4 allows integration with the gaps stated in the ledger), but the ledger wording of V2-ION and V3 depends on the answer.
requested_input: Unavailable input (1): independent evidence of the charge dependence of lateral spreading for He/C/O in water at 50–430 MeV/u, i.e. measured lateral dose widths or angular spreads with stated uncertainties (candidates Parodi 2013, Schwaab 2011, Tessonnier 2017: no open numeric tables found), or an accessible single-scattering MC reference whose screened-Coulomb cross-section physics is independent of the model used by the exact-Ω mapping; a reference that shares the screened Rutherford law and Molière's Born screening form (including the Geant4 single-scattering configuration of V5-SS, G4IonCoulombScatteringModel, branch B) does not satisfy this input. Unavailable input (2): independent coverage of the f_dM evaluation beyond its 300 MeV proton-qualified domain (proton-equivalent states up to about 2.5 GeV at the standard points and upper ends), declared and bounded only within the same Molière theory (row I11-ext). Unavailable input (3, row V3): measured ranges of carbon and oxygen ions in water, i.e. Bragg-peak and/or R80 positions with stated uncertainties together with the water-equivalent thickness of the beam-line elements upstream of the water, at energies within 80–430 MeV/u (C) and 100–430 MeV/u (O) (candidates: GSI precision Bragg curves (Schardt et al. 2007), HIT numeric tables (Tessonnier 2017, Krämer 2016, Kurz 2012)). Please choose for the lateral input: (A) provide the measured lateral data (e.g. Tessonnier 2017 / HIT σ(z) tables for p, He, C, O in water with uncertainties, or the Schwaab 2011 tables) as files the reference-data tool can acquire; (B) provide, or authorise a route to, an independent-physics single-scattering or angular-distribution reference whose screened-Coulomb cross section is independent of Molière's screened Rutherford law with the Born screening form (not the Geant4 G4IonCoulombScatteringModel / G4eCoulombScatteringModel lineage); (C) accept that V3-008 integrates with ion lateral spreading supported only by theory-derived mapping and implementation checks and by shared-lineage single-scattering MC evidence (V5-SS; no independent evidence), and with the f_dM extrapolation as a declared limitation (a ≤ 1.5 % component of the ±5 % model uncertainty), both recorded as gaps in the ledger. And for the measured-range input: (D) provide measured C/O Bragg-peak or R80 positions in water with uncertainties and the beam-line water-equivalent offsets as files the reference-data tool can acquire; (E) accept that row V3 stays an EVIDENCE GAP in the ledger. Any data provided would be used in a pre-registered amendment row before use, never as construction or calibration.
